gloss: to distinguish; to differentiate; to tell apart

definitions.gloss: to distinguish; to differentiate; to tell apart
definitions.explanation: To recognize or identify the differences between two or more things and treat them accordingly. Used for both concrete distinctions (telling similar objects apart) and abstract ones (categorizing concepts).

examples.english: To distinguish between good and evil.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{区別|くべつ}しにくい。
examples.english: These two words are hard to tell apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦プライベート→プライベート：11277_puraibeeto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧{区別|くべつ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I clearly distinguish between work and personal life.

examples.japanese: {色覚|しきかく}⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{区別|くべつ}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: People with color vision deficiency may have difficulty distinguishing red from green.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{区|く}→〜区：01997_ku⟧ (section, divide) and ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate, different). Emphasizes the act of drawing a clear line between things and classifying them into separate categories. Can also be used as a noun: ⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない (can't tell the difference).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{区別|くべつ}する: to distinguish A from B
- ⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない: unable to tell the difference
- ⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: able to tell the difference
- ⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧{区別|くべつ}する: to distinguish clearly
- ⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without distinction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧: to tell apart by looking — emphasizes visual identification
- ⟦{識別|しきべつ}→識別：06785_shikibetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to identify, discriminate — more technical; used in scientific or formal contexts
- ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}する→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧: to classify, categorize — focuses on sorting into groups rather than perceiving differences
